title: HireMe engagement event envelope (contract hireme.engage.event v1.0)
description: One analytics event as the engine receives it. Exact body item of POST /engage/v1/events. GENERATED from contracts/events/v1/catalog.yaml - do not edit. Document version 1.0.0-rc1.

event_uuid.description: UUIDv7 generated by the sender; dedupe key across GA4 and webhook. UUIDv5 only for Firebase automatic events synthesised by the engine (D-072).

event_ts.description: ISO-8601 with offset. Device time for client events, server time for server events.

user_id.description: Null only for pre-login and automatic events (see user_id_nullable).

user_pseudo_id.description: Firebase app instance id. Required for client events; optional for server events (D-069).

source.description: Set by the engine adapter on ingest; ignored if a sender sets it.

received_at.description: Stamped by the engine on ingest.

price_sensitivity.description: owner: engine; ENGINE (app must not set, D-062)

marketing_opt_in_push.description: owner: backend; NOW -> GA4 (segmentation only; consent truth is the Rider API, D-053)

marketing_opt_in_wa.description: owner: backend; NOW -> GA4 (segmentation only). Short name: GA4 user property names are max 24 chars

user_properties.description: Only properties that changed. All values are strings (Firebase setUserProperty, D-070).
